description_expanded:
Providence Cottage in Rosemary Beach is located south of 30a and is the 3rd home from gulf itself. A new renovation took place in 2024 featuring new bathrooms, furniture, etc!

We provide passes to access all 4 Rosemary Beach Community pools, and any of the 9 Beach Walkovers

All towels, bed linens, blankets, comforters, and pillow/mattress protectors are professionally laundered for every new reservation!

2 Kings

1 Queen

3 Twins

1 Full Bunk

1 Twin Bunk

This rare beach address is truly just steps to the Main Street cafes and Western Green. It's the perfect location to walk quickly down to the beach and back.

Pecky cypress ceilings, bright wood walls, and rustic barn flooring combine with all new modern clean bathrooms to make this home a memorable vacation rental spot.

The carriage house is an additional charge and is rented separately (vrbo #680098). This renovated showpiece sleeps 4 guests in a 2 BR/ 2 BA floorplan.

Providence Cottage features:

* 1 Garage Parking Space, Fits Suv: Tahoe, X7, Expedition. Extended suvs will not fit. Passes for street parking additional cars provided.

* Kitchen designed to cook while entertaining

* Two full sized Subzero refrigerators

* Wolf 6 burner gas range & grill

* Bosch dishwasher

* 2nd floor covered porch with gulf view

* 3rd floor balcony with gulf view

1st floor:

Master BR with new bath & shower (KING)

Bedroom 2 with new full bathroom with bathtub combo (2 TWINS + 1 Trundle)

2nd floor:

Dining, kitchen, living, full bath, wet bar, 3 balconies

3rd floor:

Bedroom 3 - King bed and new full bath with shower

Bedroom 4 - Queen bed and new bath with shower. Gulf view balcony (QUEEN)

Bunk 1 - full bunk with TV & privacy curtain

Bunk 2 - twin bunk alcove with TV & door

* Wetbar with U-Line wine cooler & ice machine

* new washer/dryer on the first floor

* wireless internet

* flat panel TVs

* Weber outdoor gas grill

Three levels of living maximize the space for privacy as well as family get togethers. Fully equipped kitchen features a built-in Miele coffee machine, microwave, dishwasher, farm sink and wet bar copper sink. The Barbados pool (2 min) and Coquina Pool (4 min) are an easy and enjoyable walk away. Boardwalk H is truly outside the front door. Luxurious appointments, professionally cleaned and managed. We look forward to hosting you!
